description: This file defines the MultiTrustManager class, which implements a custom X509TrustManager for managing multiple KeyStores and verifying trusted certificates in SSL contexts.

classes.name: MultiTrustManager
classes.description: A custom implementation of X509TrustManager that manages multiple KeyStores and verifies certificates against them.

methods.name: MultiTrustManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the trust manager with a single KeyStore.

methods.name: MultiTrustManager
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes an empty list of KeyStores.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a KeyStore to the list of trusted stores.

methods.name: getNumberOfKeyStores
methods.description: Returns the number of KeyStores managed.

methods.name: checkClientTrusted
methods.description: Checks if the client certificates are trusted based on the stored KeyStores.

methods.name: checkServerTrusted
methods.description: Checks if the server certificates are trusted based on the stored KeyStores.

methods.name: getAcceptedIssuers
methods.description: Returns an array of trusted X509Certificates from all managed KeyStores.

methods.name: isTrusted
methods.description: Determines if a given certificate chain is trusted by comparing with accepted issuers.
